{{Quote|It's a vicious, monstrous beast with huge fangs and large claws.|Mat Rags|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref>}}
The '''krayt dragon''' was a large carnivorous reptile native to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. At least two different species were known to exist, the [[Canyon krayt dragon/Legends|canyon krayt dragon]] and the [[Greater krayt dragon/Legends|greater krayt dragon]].<ref name="Wildlife">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>

==Characteristics and species==
{{Quote|What made the Sand People leave?''"<br />"''I imitated the hunting cry of a krayt dragon. Their imaginations did the rest and they took to their heels.|Luke Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Star Wars radio">[[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio drama]]</ref>}}
[[File:GreaterKrayt.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A krayt dragon]]
Krayt dragons grew continuously throughout their lives to an average length of almost forty five meters and weight of two thousand kilograms. They could live for a hundred years and did not weaken appreciably with age. They could be found in the mountain regions of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="NEGAS" /> An ancient krayt dragon was the oldest and biggest of all krayt dragons.

A fierce hunter, the krayt dragon became an important part of indigenous cultures on Tatooine. The krayt dragon was thought by some xenobiologists to have descended from the [[Duinuogwuin/Legends|Duinuogwuin]] (also known as Star Dragons). Although no substantial evidence was offered in support of a connection to the Duinuogwuin, the krayt dragon was a proven relative of the smaller [[Kell dragon/Legends|kell dragon]]. In honor of the beast's sheer power and ferocity, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] named the [[Form V/Legends|Shien and Djem So]] form of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] "The Way of the Krayt Dragon."

The only [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] known to hunt the krayt dragon was the fabled [[sand demon]].

When summer mating season began, the howls of krayt dragons filled the canyons of Tatooine.<ref name="NEGAS" /> The collection of frenzied, mating beasts scared even the mightiest [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] away. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] mimicked a krayt dragon hunting cry when he scared the raiders away from [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Star Wars radio" /> Skywalker himself later used the same tactic in an attempt to scare a [[vornskr]].<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>

[[File:Krayttusken.png|thumb|160px|Two Tusken Raiders attempt to slay a krayt dragon.]]
Sand People would hunt krayt dragons in an initiation rite to prove themselves as warriors. It was considered the most prestigious test for a Tusken warrior.<ref name="TUVG">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', "A Jedi in Exile,"</ref>

The krayt dragon had a set of sharp teeth used for capturing prey, but relied on ingesting stones to grind the food through a series of gizzards into a digestible state. Food would be crushed by the stones tumbled in the gizzards by stomach muscles, grinding food into pulp and turning boulders into smooth stones. The resulting stones, known as [[Krayt dragon pearl/Legends|dragon pearls]], were a valuable commodity among jewelers. The pearls could also be shaped and tuned by Jedi to be used as focusing crystals in their lightsabers. Krayt dragons instinctively went to the [[Krayt Graveyard]] when they were about to die.

Krayt dragons were heavily attracted to areas that were strong in the Force, especially the dark side. Some Sith artifacts, like the Tatooine [[Star Map]], were guarded by krayt dragons.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

In spite of their awesome power, krayt dragons did have weak and exploitable biological characteristics. Firstly, krayt dragons had trouble resisting the allure of the prey of the Dune Sea, specifically the bantha. Secondly, they had difficulty discerning two-dimensional images, often attacking shadows. Thirdly, a well-placed blaster shot could bore right through the weak [[Sinuses|sinus cavity]] of a krayt dragon, hitting its brain and killing it instantly.

The krayt could also secrete a lethal [[Krayt dragon venom/Legends|venom]], either through its teeth or its spines. Although its nature is unclear, numerous underworld characters such as [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]] have admitted to using the substance to kill enemies.

Although some [[Holodrama/Legends|holofilms]], such as the [[holothriller]] ''[[Luke Skywalker and the Dragons of Tatooine]]'', depicted krayt dragons breathing [[Fire/Legends|fire]], they were in reality incapable of this.<ref name="Shadows of Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>

Krayt dragon meat was edible. The cookbook ''[[Essential Cooking Skills]]'' detailed how to best cook that meat.<ref name="SWG:ECS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|ESSENTIAL COOKING SKILLS}}</ref>

==Species==
At least two species and several subspecies of krayt dragons existed.
[[File:Krayt-swg1.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A [[Canyon krayt dragon/Legends|canyon krayt dragon]] in the deserts of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]]]

===Canyon krayt dragon===
{{Main|Canyon krayt dragon/Legends}}
The [[Canyon krayt dragon/Legends|''canyon krayt'']] was a common species of krayt dragon that lived in the rocky caves and canyons of Tatooine's desert ranges. More often than not, the term "krayt dragon" referred to this lifeform. Patterns of horns and spikes appears to have varied from individual to individual. At least one canyon krayt was noted to have a two-pronged tail.

[[File:GreaterKrayt-WOSW.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Greater krayt dragon/Legends|Greater krayt dragon]]]]

===Greater krayt dragon===
{{Main|Greater krayt dragon/Legends}}
The [[Greater krayt dragon/Legends|''greater krayt'']] was a rarer, larger species of krayt dragon, known for its tremendous size and continual growth over time. Creatures of near legendary status, greater krayt dragons had ten legs, measured at least 100 meters from snout to tail tip and had the ability to move through or on Tatooine's desert sand. Greater krayt dragons attacked with their massive jaws or whip-like spike-tail, using their claws only to move through the sand.

==Krayts in Tatooine culture==
[[File:Kraytbones.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] walks near the spine and skull of a greater krayt dragon on Tatooine.]]
{{Quote|From the womb of the krayt, be blessed with rebirth. You are her killer and her child&mdash;a greater dragon than she! Pull from her belly your prize&hellip; and her apology.|An ancient Tusken invocation|<ref name="Star Wars: Republic: Outlander">''[[Star Wars: Outlander]]''</ref>}}
The Sand People of Tatooine revered the krayt dragon as a powerful hunter and centered their primary maturity ritual on it. Adolescent males were abandoned in the Tatooine dune and only accepted back into their tribes as adults when they had slain a krayt dragon. Both the Sand People and [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] placed the krayt dragon in the position of a powerful spirit, and believed that their bones possessed magic. Jawas brave enough to risk the acquisition of krayt dragon bones were held in high regard among their people.

A krayt dragon skeleton was exhibited at the [[Corellian Science Museum]] during the [[Galactic War]], and a painting of a krayt dragon skeleton was on display in [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine's]] [[Museum of Tatooine/Legends|Museum of Tatooine]].

[[File:Corellian_Science_Museum.png|thumb|right|230px|A krayt dragon skeleton exhibited at the Corellian Science Museum.]]
[[Revan/Legends|Revan]], who was an amnesiac and searching for the [[Star Forge]] to stop [[Darth Malak]], killed a krayt dragon with the help of [[Komad Fortuna]] in order to find an ancient Star Map. He collected the krayt dragon's pearl, but what he did with it is unknown. He either gave it to the Sand People so he could be permitted to learn their history, or he may have kept it to make his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] stronger.

The Sand People often made fearsome-looking backpacks from the skulls of krayt dragons.

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] was captured by [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla]] and was forced to battle her [[Gardulla's krayt dragon|krayt dragon]], ultimately slaying the beast.<ref name="bountyhunter">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>

According to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Gavin Darklighter]], Krayt Dragons were an integral part of a traditional Tatooine pre-wedding party for the groom-to-be, which is why it was perhaps fortunate that [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] was held on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], in the [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] tradition instead.<ref name="union">''[[Star Wars: Union]]''</ref>

[[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who lived among the Sand People with [[Sharad Hett|his father]], took the name Darth Krayt after the dragons upon becoming a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]].{{Talesstart}}In [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and another boy called [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Annie]] encountered a krayt dragon during a sandstorm and Luke was able to kill it with a [[Gaderffii stick|gaffii stick]] that the pair had taken from the body of a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|tusken raider]]. However, when his [[Owen Lars/Legends|Uncle Owen]] and other searchers found Luke there was no sign of the other boy or the dragon and believed the experience to be a hallucination due to [[dust fever]]. <ref name="Sandstorm comic">{{Tales|15|Sandstorm (comic story)}}</ref>{{Talesend}}[[File:KraytDragon-CotF.jpg|thumb|A krayt dragon attacks Tatooinian residents.]]

==Behind the scenes==
The artificial skeleton used for [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']] was left in the Tunisian desert after filming and still lies there. During filming of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']], the site was visited by the crew and the skeleton was still found there. A [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] made from a krayt dragon skull was one of the many items available to players in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.

Krayt dragons were intended to first appear in ''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]'' but they were renamed [[Kell dragon/Legends|kell dragons]] and became a different (but related) species altogether.
